headline: Track presence through an Actiontec router
intro: The Actiontec integration detects presence by looking at devices connected to an Actiontec router. The documented tested device is the MI424WR (Verizon FIOS); telnet must be enabled on the router for this device tracker to work.
highlights: Detect presence from devices connected to an Actiontec router
Enable telnet on the router before using the device tracker
Configure the router IP address and administrative username and password in configuration.yaml

flow.title: Set up Actiontec presence detection
stages: Enable telnet on the Actiontec router
Add the actiontec device_tracker configuration with the router host and admin credentials
Restart Home Assistant and configure the people to be tracked
